channel.title: Teppei Nakano — Reading notes
channel.description: One takeaway per paper for local LLMs and medical ML

item.title: The shaky foundations of large language models and foundation models for electronic health records
item.description: Before the task name, I check whether EHR foundation-model labels are billing or annotation, and whether the split is by patient.

item.title: AI for radiographic COVID-19 detection selects shortcuts over signal
item.description: Imaging models pick laterality markers and site style before disease. Before saliency, I ask whether the embedding predicts the hospital.

item.title: Variable generalization performance of a deep learning model to detect pneumonia in chest radiographs
item.description: In-hospital AUROC dies next door. I read pneumonia papers for scanner and protocol text before the leaderboard.

item.title: Dissecting racial bias in an algorithm used to manage the health of populations
item.description: Cost as a proxy for risk learns access. I write what the teacher stands in for before I write the loss.

item.title: The myth of generalisability in clinical research and machine learning in health care
item.description: Generalisation is a report of which shifts you survived, not a property. I do not call a single AUROC generalisable.

item.title: Scalable and accurate deep learning with electronic health records
item.description: Ingesting the EHR as a sequence is not the result. The result is whether anything after time t leaked in.

item.title: MIMIC-III, a freely accessible critical care database
item.description: The default public ICU set. I read which MIMIC version, whether patients collide, and whether clocks agree.

item.title: Hidden stratification causes clinically meaningful failures in machine learning for medical imaging
item.description: Rare subtypes sink under mean AUROC. If the stratum is not a label, the mean hides it.

item.title: The Precision-Recall Plot Is More Informative than the ROC Plot When Evaluating Binary Classifiers on Imbalanced Datasets
item.description: On imbalance, PR comes first. AUROC can look high while almost every page is a miss.

item.title: Tackling the widespread and critical impact of batch effects in high-throughput data
item.description: Batch can outrun biology. I put a cross-study split before the correction.

item.title: Adjusting batch effects in microarray expression data using empirical Bayes methods
item.description: ComBat shrinks batch mean and variance. Re-estimating on the test study leaks the evaluation.

item.title: A simple algorithm for identifying negated findings and diseases in discharge summaries
item.description: Half of clinical text is absence. Extraction that ignores negation doubles the findings.

item.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
item.description: Contiguous KV leaves holes. Paging the cache is how the same VRAM holds a batch.

item.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
item.description: Attention is slow from HBM traffic, not from approximation. Tile it; keep it exact.

item.title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints
item.description: Sharing K/V heads cuts KV bytes before it cuts quality. That is the local-inference estimate.

item.title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
item.description: Positions are rotated, not added. Relative offset enters the dot product. Long-context work is about those periods.

item.title: Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks
item.description: A sliding window breaks unless you keep the first tokens. The sink is a lemma of the window.

item.title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
item.description: A small model drafts; the large one verifies. Wall time shrinks only when rejects stay rare.

item.title: LLM.int8(): 8-bit Matrix Multiplication for Transformers at Scale
item.description: Even at 8-bit, outlier channels stay in 16-bit. Quantization is not a uniform shave.

item.title: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for LLM Compression and Acceleration
item.description: Weight importance follows activation magnitude. MSE alone drops the channels you needed.

item.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
item.description: Add a low-rank delta. Choose which matrices before you choose rank.

item.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
item.description: Given preference pairs, you can update the policy without a reward model. Pair quality precedes the loss.

item.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
item.description: SFT, then reinforce from human preference. The template for “aligning” a local stack.

item.title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
item.description: Each token picks one expert. Compute is sparse; memory still pays for every expert.

item.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
item.description: Retrieve before you generate. Do not bake the knowledge into weights. Score retrieval and generation apart.

item.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
item.description: Put questions and passages in one space. Before dropping BM25, I look at what dense retrieval catches and drops.

item.title: Attention Is All You Need
item.description: Drop recurrence; make distance constant with attention. Current decoders keep one side of this paper.

item.title: Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization
item.description: Decouple decay from the gradient. That is not Adam plus L2. Leave Norm γ out of decay.

item.title: Root Mean Square Layer Normalization
item.description: No mean subtraction; divide by RMS. With pre-norm, that is current decoder normalization.

item.title: On Layer Normalization in the Transformer Architecture
item.description: Pre-norm leaves the residual as an identity. That is one reason a deep decoder trains.

item.title: The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration
item.description: Argmax loops. Temperature is not enough. Cut the tail with a nucleus (top-p).

item.title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
item.description: Move the shape of the teacher’s logits, with a temperature. Relations survive better than hard labels.

item.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
item.description: Deeper, stronger nets are worse calibrated. I put ECE and temperature scaling next to AUROC.

item.title: Representation Learning with Contrastive Predictive Coding
item.description: Pick the positive out of noise. InfoNCE became the name of that loss.

item.title: Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units
item.description: Split rare words into subwords. The tokenizer is part of the model, not preprocessing.
